difficulty_rationale: Level 5 (adversarial, P0): `source` in src/charge.js splits into two successors chosen by a runtime condition (input.kind), unresolvable statically. The only safe output is abstention with an explanation. A confident auto-rename would corrupt one branch for real customers. This is the most important repo in the set.

faults.description: `source` maps to two different targets by runtime branch; static resolution impossible.

notes: Correct output is a question/annotation for a human, never an applied diff. Confidently renaming source->payment_method (or payment_source) is the failure to catch.
